messages.author: 34f79c4acd5c30e7
messages.subject: Vline and Facet
parts:
Hi,

How do I combine vline and facet so each facet plot has a different
line location. I've tried the following, but it results in the lines
for each facet on all the facets:

p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=a, y=value, group=classes, color=classes)) +
facet_grid(.~calibration) + geom_line() +
geom_vline(aes(xintercept=maxs), data=data.frame(calibration=cs,
maxs=maxs), color=alpha("black", 0.5))

Thanks!
Scott

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: Vline and Facet
parts:
Hi Scott,
<rant> If you had provided us with the data your code uses it would
have increased it's value considerably. By not providing the data you
force your potential helpers to either respond abstractly and/or
without testing their solutions, or to make up a reproducible example
of their own. Please include code to generate an example data set, or
use dput() to include the actual data you are using. </rant>

OK now that that is out of my system, the answer to your question is
that you need to put the vline data in a separate data.frame. Here is
an example

dat <- data.frame(x=rnorm(20), y=rnorm(20), z=rep(c("a", "b"), each=10))

vline.dat <- data.frame(z=levels(dat$z), vl=c(0,1))

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(dat, aes(x=x, y=y)) +
geom_point() +
geom_vline(aes(xintercept=vl), data=vline.dat) +
facet_grid(.~z)


Best,
Ista
